---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Persistent Operating-Capital Earnings Value
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(oancf, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), MUL(INDICATOR(TS_MIN(ebitda, 3), 0), IND_RANK(TREND(RATIO(ebitda, ADD(ppent, invt)), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap cash-generative firms with persistently improving earnings productivity across total fixed and inventory capital earn higher returns.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: PP&E plus inventory forms a direct operating-capital denominator, avoiding a mechanical MIN merge of separate fixed-asset and inventory signals. The positive-EBITDA history condition preserves unambiguous productivity comparative statics while the trend captures sustained improvement rather than a low capital-stock level.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Liquidity-Safe Capital Recycling
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(oancf, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), MIN(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(capx, DELTA(ppegt, 1)), LAG(ppegt, 1)), 1)), IND_RANK(RATIO(che, ADD(che, capx)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap cash-generative firms outperform when they recycle obsolete capital without exhausting liquidity relative to current investment spending.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The recycling leg supplies evidence of active retirement or replacement, preventing the cash-coverage ratio from scoring firms solely because capex is negligible. Funding slack provides an economically distinct check on whether the recycling program is financially sustainable rather than a distressed asset-disposal episode.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Earnings-Validated Rejuvenation
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(oancf, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), MIN(IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(ppent, ppegt), 1)), IND_RANK(RATIO(DELTA(ebitda, 1), ADD(ABS(DELTA(ebitda, 1)), LAG(capx, 1))))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap cash-generative firms outperform when asset rejuvenation is followed by strong operating-profit payback on prior capex.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Asset-age improvement establishes that the productive base was renewed, while bounded EBITDA payback verifies that the renewal generated an operating benefit. This separates economically successful modernization from accounting-driven age changes or capex that merely expands capacity.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Funded Margin-Creating Investment
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(oancf, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), MIN(MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(che, ADD(che, capx))), IND_RANK(RATIO(capx, at))), IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(ebitda, sale), 1))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap cash-generative firms earn higher returns when meaningful, liquidity-covered investment produces operating-margin expansion.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The funding and capex-intensity legs retain the jointly strong active-investment mechanism, while margin expansion requires a realized operating outcome. The three-way weakest link prevents low capex, idle cash, or margin improvement without investment from driving the score independently.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Liquidity-Preserving Total-Factor Value
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(che, ADD(che, capx))), MIN(IND_RANK(TREND(RATIO(sale, emp), 3)), IND_RANK(TREND(RATIO(sale, ppent), 3)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap firms that improve both labor and fixed-capital productivity while retaining liquidity relative to current capex outperform.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Persistent total-factor improvement has delivered strong cross-sectional evidence but more modest portfolio alpha, while liquidity coverage has been strongest in portfolio tests. Their conjunction targets firms whose productivity gains are achieved without consuming financial flexibility, rather than simply stacking high cash with low installed capital.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Cash-Productive Capital Recycling
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), MIN(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(capx, DELTA(ppegt, 1)), LAG(ppegt, 1)), 1)), IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(oancf, ppent), 1))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap profitable firms outperform when capital recycling is accompanied by improved operating cash flow per unit of net PP&E.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The recycling family has produced exceptionally strong Fama-MacBeth slopes, but portfolio alpha improves only when an independent operating outcome validates the accounting proxy. Cash productivity supplies a stricter realization test than asset-age changes and directly targets abnormal cash generation from the remaining productive base.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---CRITIQUE Persistent Operating-Capital Earnings Value---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This is a denominator swap on two archive signals already tested with the identical structure (Persistent Fixed-Capital Earnings Value uses TREND(ebitda/ppent) and Profitable Inventory Productivity Trend uses the same EBITDA-positivity gate with TREND(ebitda/(ebitda+invt))), so it is a cosmetic variant rather than a new mechanism.

---CRITIQUE Liquidity-Safe Capital Recycling---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Beyond being a third recombination of the already-tested recycling leg with the already-tested che/(che+capx) leg, the two legs pull mechanically against each other — the recycling proxy requires capx to exceed gross PP&E growth while the liquidity ratio mechanically rewards small capx — so the conjunction risks selecting low-capex disposal cases rather than the hypothesized sustainable replacement programs.

---CRITIQUE Earnings-Validated Rejuvenation---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Both legs (DELTA(ppent/ppegt) rejuvenation and the bounded EBITDA-per-lagged-capex payback) have each already been tested against the same oancf-yield anchor in the archive (Rejuvenated-Asset Value Gate, Productive Renewal Value, Operating-Profit Payback Value, Payoff-Validated Capital Optionality), making this a mechanical MIN pairing of existing components with no new economic content.

---CRITIQUE Funded Margin-Creating Investment---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This simply appends the weaker Investment-Enabled Margin Expansion leg to the fully-tested Funded Active-Investment Value expression as a third weakest-link term, which is an incremental stacking of archive components likely to shrink effective spread and coverage rather than a substantively different mechanism.

---CRITIQUE Liquidity-Preserving Total-Factor Value---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Still a conjunction of previously tested legs, but the proposal is explicitly motivated by the diagnosed FMB-strong/alpha-weak split in the total-factor family and the liquidity-coverage leg is economically distinct from productivity trends, so the test carries genuine incremental information despite three-way MIN attenuation risk.

---CRITIQUE Cash-Productive Capital Recycling---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Replacing DELTA(sale/ppent) with DELTA(oancf/ppent) in the already-evaluated Output-Verified Capital Recycling expression is a near-identical validation-leg substitution, and the cash-flow numerator additionally overlaps with the oancf-based value anchor family, so little independent evidence is expected.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Capacity-Utilization Resilience Value
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(oancf, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_MIN(RATIO(sale, ppent), 5), TS_MAX(RATIO(sale, ppent), 5))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap cash-generative firms that preserve productive-capacity utilization through their operating cycle earn higher returns.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio
REASONING: The minimum-to-maximum utilization ratio measures downside resilience relative to each firm’s own peak rather than another earnings-productivity denominator or trend. This normalization also reduces the static asset-lightness exposure that would arise from ranking the level of sales-to-PP&E alone.

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Utilization-Matched Investment Value
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(oancf, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), IND_RANK(NEG(ABS(SUB(TS_RANK(RATIO(sale, ppent), 5), TS_RANK(RATIO(capx, ppegt), 5))))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap cash-generative firms outperform when capital-spending intensity is matched to firm-specific capacity utilization.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
REASONING: This abandons the mechanically conflicting cash-coverage and recycling conjunction. A small gap between the two historical positions rewards both restraint during low utilization and investment during high utilization, measuring capital-budget timing rather than investment level.

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Non-Goodwill Intangible Value
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(oancf, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(intan, gdwl), ADD(ABS(SUB(intan, gdwl)), gdwl)), 1)))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap cash-generative firms whose intangible asset base is tilted away from goodwill earn higher subsequent returns.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio
REASONING: This replaces the mechanical pairing of previously tested rejuvenation and payback legs with an investment-composition mechanism. A high non-goodwill share identifies identifiable intangible capital rather than acquisition premia, while winsorization limits accounting classification anomalies.

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Balanced Replacement Value
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(oancf, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), IND_RANK(NEG(ABS(RATIO(DELTA(ppent, 1), ADD(ABS(DELTA(ppent, 1)), capx))))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap cash-generative firms whose capex primarily maintains the productive asset base rather than driving expansion or contraction earn higher returns.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
REASONING: The bounded net-PP&E-change share decomposes capex into expansion versus replacement without appending another condition to the funded-investment signal. Scoring values near zero rewards maintenance investment while penalizing both aggressive net expansion and distressed asset shedding.

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Capital-Deepening Efficiency Value
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(TREND(RATIO(sale, emp), 3), TREND(RATIO(ppent, emp), 3)), ADD(ABS(TREND(RATIO(sale, emp), 3)), ABS(TREND(RATIO(ppent, emp), 3))))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap firms whose output per employee improves faster than productive capital per employee earn higher subsequent returns.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio
REASONING: This measures the payoff to capital deepening directly rather than substituting one validation numerator into the archived recycling expression. The bounded trend spread identifies labor-productivity gains that cannot be explained merely by supplying each worker with more PP&E.
